nodes.name: Button.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable Button UI component for the shared component library, exporting a styled button with variant and size props using class-name merging via cn.

nodes.name: Card.tsx
nodes.summary: Exports three composable Card UI primitives (Card, CardTitle, CardSection) with tone and className props for building content panels in the ERP frontend.

nodes.name: cn.ts
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper around clsx that provides a unified cn() utility for merging Tailwind class names across all shared UI components.
nodes.languageNotes: Delegates to clsx for conditional class merging; a common pattern in Tailwind-based component libraries.
